title: Implants from Roger Leir's surgeries, one sending a radio signal

plain: Whitley Strieber, a writer known for describing his own encounters with beings he believes are not human, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about the 1990s work of Roger Leir, a surgeon who removed small objects people believed were alien implants. Strieber says that among the objects from those surgeries, one was remarkable: while it sat in a person's neck, near the second vertebra, it was giving off a radio signal. If true, it would mean the objects were working devices, not just stray fragments.
